This branch (passes 1–2) gave each of the 10 defensive/life keywords a beat on the #2782 machinery: Divine Shield and Armor fold into the `ward` motif, Indestructible keys on the lethal absorption its Armor reports, Immutable and Immune to Spells key on the grant that raises their shell/ward, Reborn keys on `summoned` with `via: Reborn`, Brittle grows cracks on damage plus a shatter callout on death, Taunt raises a dust-ring wall on arrival plus a pull on forced attacks, and Can't Defend / Can't attack clink chains over the skipped/chosen unit — all with callout caps, speed scaling, reduced-motion still callouts, intensity `off` silence, and named constants.
